title: CoolGuy42443's Classes
description: A bunch of new classes that all give a different gameplay experience.
body:
Classes is a Minecraft 1.21.8 mod that adds different types of classes that players can choose from when joining a world/server. Every class has its benefits and debuffs all giving a different Minecraft experience. The mod currently has 7 classes but will improve and get more. Mod works on both singleplayer and multiplayer. --- **Classes:**
Human:
+Regular Minecraft experience Lumberjack:
+Spawn in with a stone axe
+Permanent Haste effect Cursed:
+Get a full set of iron tools on spawn
-Permanent Unluck and Bad omen effcets Zombie:
+Permanent Strength effect
-Permanent Hunger effect Cat:
+Permanent Night vision effect
+Permanent Speed and Jump boost effects
-Shrink in size and lose 3 hearts Hero:
+Permanent Hero of the village effect
+Permanent Strength effect
-Permanent Mining fatigue effect GOD:
+++GOD has no weaknesses. He is absolute power.
-There can only be one GOD every world/server. Warden:
+Gain three times regular health
-Gain permanent Slowness and Darkness
-Slightly become bigger Fish:
+Gain permanent Water breathing
-Lose 3 hearts of health and become smaller Werewolf:
+Gain Strength effect when it is night time
-Gain Weakness effect when it is day time And many more classes! --- **Credits:** Mod by CoolGuy42443 Inspired by the Origins mod created by Apace I recommend you try the Origins mod as well: https://modrinth.com/mod/origins https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/origins --- **Mod made using MCreator**
